field_principles.accuracy_cost_pareto: Compute/latency ratio at equal accuracy -- the efficiency-parity win condition (north-star §5; arXiv:2504.01005).
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A clean positive, a clean (headroom-present) null, or a gated deferral are ALL COMPLETE.
field_principles.moat_delta_vs_vote: pass@1(A) - pass@1(B) with CI95 -- the accuracy axis of the moat, now measured WHERE headroom exists.
field_principles.moat_vs_matched_control: pass@1(A) - pass@1(C) -- proves a win is the verifier, not extra adaptation compute (arXiv:2511.02886).
field_principles.positive_control_confirmed: Bare bool: oracle@k > SC-vote AND >=1 flip occurred on this corpus -- without it the null is uninformative (FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK).
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition for reproducibility of the decisive measurement.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content hash of candidate pool + verifier config; lets a third party re-run the decisive test.
field_principles.verifier_value_added: Bare bool: did ARM A beat SC-vote (CI95 excl 0) OR match it at lower cost? Resolves the moat question and the DiffusionGemma gate when headroom is present.
